children: US President Donald Trump said in a Truth Social post on Friday that his administration is sending checks of nearly $100 to more than 20 million seniors to pay for their Medicare Part B premiums.
The White House said in a fact sheet on its website that the federal government will be making one-time payments of $90 per person to help the seniors pay for their Medicare premiums.
